values: 一名潜藏幕后的法师，善于在博弈游戏中施展诡计胜过敌人。
A mage who lurks in the shadows, outwitting his opponents through cunning trickery.
看来我又多了一份看戏的资本。
筹码已下，猜猜看谁会先出去。
High stakes? Who will fall first?
准备好支付这一局的筹码了？
Are you prepared to pay the price of this game?
真假虚实不过一念之间。
Truth and falsehood are but a flicker of the mind.
Huh. I found the crack in the riddle.
Is this your way of testing the waters?
Is this your way of testing the waters?
Since we have no pressing matters, shall we indulge in a game?
这里的存在不是秘密，属实可惜
It's a pity a place like this isn't kept hidden from the world.
茶很好，可惜……我的口味独特
The tea is fine... but my palate is particular.
埃德加的霁月会馆每晚都会变换实际的位置，但唯一的入口只在墓园的棺椁之中。
Eryndor's Twilight Pavilion changes location every night, but one thing never changes: its entrance lies within a coffin in the graveyard.
埃德加几乎不收取钱财作为报酬，他的报酬往往是一个能左右王室的丑闻，或是一句沉甸甸的生死承诺。
Eryndor does not deal in money. His price is either a scandal that could tarnish the royal family's name or a solemn vow bound by life and death.
外界盛传埃德加用残酷的血之契约控制着隐士，但他的某位并不忠实的手下对此嗤之以鼻。
Rumor has it that Eryndor keeps every member of the Solitaries under his control through brutal blood pacts, but one of his less-than-loyal subordinates scoffs at the idea.
据说埃德加白天都睡在一具华丽的棺材里，棺材底部铺的不是绸缎，而是各种情报的羊皮纸。
It is said that Eryndor spends his days sleeping in an exquisite coffin lined not with silk, but with parchments bearing secrets of every kind.
老一辈的贵族声称在他们祖父那一代就见过埃德加，而且样貌没有任何变化。
According to the elderly nobles, Eryndor looks exactly as he did when their grandfathers crossed paths with him, generations ago.
曾有人好奇过埃德加是否是他真实的名字，答案是——不是。但这并不重要。因为真正的名字，只对活着的人有意义。
When asked whether Eryndor was his real name, he simply answered no. He attaches little importance to names, believing they only matter to the living.
埃德加从不直接操纵权力，而是将秘密视为世界运转的真正动力，他享受通过掌握秘密来参与历史进程的愉悦感。
Eryndor has no desire to wield power directly. Instead, he sees secrets as the true force behind the workings of the world, and relishes shaping the course of history with those at his disposal.
霁月会馆常年笼罩在极其庞大的魔法幻术中。所有踏入其中的访客都无法以真面目示人，服务人员除外。
Due to the vast illusion perpetually shrouding the Twilight Pavilion, the true appearance of every guest there is concealed, while the staff alone remain unaffected.
埃德加拥有近乎完美的记忆力。他能微笑着、一字不差地复述出十年前某个谈话的内容和表情细节。
Eryndor has the memory of an elephant. He can effortlessly recount every word of a conversation from ten years ago, down to every subtle expression exchanged.
埃德加长期保留着品茶的习惯，只是那精致瓷杯中盛装的茶，总是散发着一种甜腻且危险的铁锈味。
Drinking tea has long been a habit of Eryndor's. But for some reason, the tea served in his delicate porcelain cups always carries a cloying, dangerous scent of blood.
霁月会馆里的景象，很有趣吧。梅林阁下，您不觉得吗？
The Twilight Pavilion is a fascinating place, don't you think?
进入霁月会馆的方法……很别致吧。
The way into the Twilight Pavilion is rather unusual, isn't it?
梅林阁下，您看这枚青符。在赌徒眼里，它是翻盘的希望。在商人眼里，它是流通的货币。
Look at this Azure Token, Magister Merlin. To a gambler, it's a second chance. To a merchant, it's money.
维伦，这里有一个调查走私线路的长期任务。
Valen, there's a long-term assignment here involving the investigation of smuggling routes.
Since we have no pressing matters, shall we indulge in a game?
茶很好，可惜……我的口味独特
The tea is fine... but my palate is particular.
